# Contact us

**Do you have questions for our sales team?** Reach out [here](https://funnel.io/get-in-touch).

**Are you an existing customer?** Write to us at: [support@funnel.io](mailto:support@funnel.io)

Check out our [Knowledge Base](https://help.funnel.io/en/) to get more information and product guides.

What can we help with?

For customer support: log in and ask Funnel AI, or contact Support from inside the app.

Can't log in? Email support@funnel.io.
